name: TC-BUT-07: Load More shows more used-truck cards on Buy Used Trucks
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/BuyUsedTrucks.cy.js#UsedTruck - BuyUsedTrucks [en] — Buy Used Trucks TC-BUT-07: Load More shows more used-truck cards on Buy Used Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUT-07
**Title:** Load More shows more used-truck cards on Buy Used Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Click Load More on Buy Used Trucks and confirm more Contact Seller cards appear.

**Expected Result:**
The number of visible Contact Seller buttons increases after Load More.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Buy Used Trucks page
2. Note how many cards are shown
3. Click Load More
4. Verify more cards are shown
